settings.heading: The right yak chew for your German Shepherd.
settings.subheading: German Shepherds are powerful, intelligent chewers. They need a dense, long-lasting chew that matches their jaw strength without risking tooth damage.
settings.estimate_note: German Shepherds are strong chewers. Most need a Large or XL. Duration depends on individual jaw strength and chew style.
settings.card_1_text: Most German Shepherds (50–90 lbs) need a Large or XL yak chew. Their strong jaws can work through a Medium too quickly. Always size up for safety.
settings.card_2_text: German Shepherds are working dogs — they need mental stimulation. A yak chew during crate time or alone time gives them a focused task that reduces anxiety and destructive behavior.
settings.card_3_text: If your GSD finishes a Large in under 30 minutes, move to XL. Supervise the first few sessions to gauge their chew intensity and adjust sizing accordingly.
